en.hubeali: From him, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban, from Misma’a who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the instigation between the animals. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> dislike that, except for the dogs’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban from Misma‘ who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about instigating animals against each other. He (the Imam) said, ‘I dislike it except dogs.’”
